title: 低位对压
description: 孔版印刷质感把对压手点和低脚点构成紧凑的斜线场景。

art_direction.medium: hand-painted oil illustration with restrained impasto
art_direction.scene: Create an original risograph-style illustration of a fictional adult starting a low compression sequence between two broad opposing holds. The hands press inward on the hold faces while both feet remain planted on visible footholds directly above the thick crash mat. Keep the body in a compact natural stance, with a small shift toward a nearby third hold rather than a forceful dynamic move. Use a diagonal medium-wide composition, layered navy and fluorescent coral inks, visible grain, and imperfect printed edges. Include the full adult body and generous empty landing space. Clothing is opaque and unbranded. No lettering, leaps, exaggerated muscles, unsafe exposure, or portrait-only framing.
